charms.name: Seven Chorus
charms.text: Each 7 in a winning hand adds 40% main-hand profit, up to three 7s. Scales with seven-heavy builds.

charms.name: Royal Court
charms.text: Each face card in a winning hand adds 25% profit, up to four. Pairs with Royal Company.

charms.name: Ace Collector
charms.text: Each Ace in a winning hand adds 35% profit, up to three. Pairs with Ace Up.

charms.name: Patchwork
charms.text: Each different suit after the first in a winning hand adds 30% profit.

charms.name: Long Haul
charms.text: Each card after the first two in a winning hand adds 30% profit, up to four extra cards.

charms.name: Phoenix Ticket
charms.text: Each Second Chance redraw used this hand adds 70% winning profit, up to three redraws.

charms.name: Forked Fate
charms.text: Each split this hand adds 50% profit to every winning main hand, up to two splits.

charms.name: Cabinet of Curios
charms.text: Each other owned Charm adds 12% winning profit, up to six Charms.

charms.name: Echo Pair
charms.text: Each adjacent same-rank pair in a winning hand adds 40% profit, up to three pairs. Pairs with Twins.

charms.name: Rolling Thunder
charms.text: Each consecutive win before this hand adds 20% profit, up to ten wins.
